Subject: Board packet: QBR OKR signal roundup & slide assembly

Team —

We need to produce a concise board packet for the QBR (scheduled Nov 18). Primary asks: consolidate OKR health signals (top-line, risks, mitigations) and assemble a 10–12 slide executive brief for the board by end of next week. Specifics: 

- Neha: please pull the OKR health summary (owner, current status, RAG signal, key commentary) across Product/Serving/Revenue and drop into the attached roster. Use the OKR_signal_dump_20261102.csv I attached as the raw source.
- Marissa: please start a draft of the board brief using the slide roster template (attached). Focus on the narrative arc: one-liner progress, two slides for key metrics (latency/cost/throughput trends), one slide for top risks, and one slide for asks.
- Tessa: coordinate a quick review slot next Wed (11/10) with the execs — 30 minutes to review the deck and major redlines.
- Jonas: flag any investor-facing items that need rephrasing before we share externally.

Deliverables/Timeline: initial draft of slides in Drive by EOD Thu (11/05), consolidated comments back by Mon (11/08), internal freeze on Tue (11/09). Board distribution on 11/12.

Attachments: QBR_slide_roster_template.xlsx (roster), OKR_signal_dump_20261102.csv (full signals).

Thanks — keep this tight. If anything looks like it will miss the timeline, cc me immediately.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance & Strategy

Thanks Naomi — started pulling the numbers. A couple of quick notes:

1) Product OKRs: the signal for "Model quality (regression rate)" is amber because two recent model rollouts increased latency variability for longer contexts. I'm adding a short explanation + mitigation (rollback plan + scheduled rollout window).
2) Serving/Infra: throughput is green overall but the cost per token for burst traffic in APAC is up 18% month-over-month; ops will include batching and a temporary routing rule to mitigate.
3) Revenue: pipeline looks ok but one large deal (AnchorCap) requested a longer SLA discussion — flagged under "Sales risks".

I attached a quick metrics slide (metrics_slide_neha_v0.1.pptx) and updated the roster with the RAG signals. I left comments inline where I need additional color (product owners should reply in the roster).

Attaching: metrics_slide_neha_v0.1.pptx (draft slide)

Neha

Nice outline — I'm attaching Board_brief_v0.2.pptx. Draft notes:

- Slide 1: Executive summary (one-liner + topline metrics).
- Slides 2–3: Key performance trends (latency P50/P95, cost per token, embedding throughput) — filled with placeholder charts.
- Slide 4: OKR heatmap (imported Neha's RAG signals).
- Slide 5: Risks & mitigations (product rollout, APAC cost spike, AnchorCap SLA ask).
- Slide 6: Asks (budget for burst capacity buffer, approval to proceed with staged rollout plan, two investor-facing rewordings).

Open items — need Neha to confirm the exact phrasing for the product mitigation and Jonas to review the investor-facing language (especially the phrasing around SLA negotiation with AnchorCap).

Quick read — looks good. Two suggestions:

1) Rework the AnchorCap note to be less contract-y; phrase it as a "sales negotiation underway, standard SLA points being reviewed" so the board knows it's an operational ask, not a looming contract risk.
2) Add a one-line context on the latency variability: "caused by longer context experiments during A/B rollout; mitigation = revert + controlled rollout". Keep the technical detail out of investor-facing slides.

I'll be ready to sign off after Neha updates the OKR phrasing. If you want, I can help craft the one-page pre-brief Tessa suggested — happy to draft it and share.

Jonas
Chief Customer Officer
